title: Design System: Aura Quest — Editorial Growth / Cut & Grow

progress-value.purpose: Real quantity/unit readout in body type.

shadows.name: custom-panel
shadows.purpose: Editorial custom panels use tonal layering. Existing Material dialogs retain platform elevation.

motion.name: progress-duration
motion.purpose: Only changed progress; initially visible, zero under reduced motion.

motion.name: progress-curve
motion.purpose: Native Flutter curve; not a CSS animation prescription.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.purpose: Small fade/slide on Editorial Android/desktop; native iOS transition retained.

components.name: Primary action — light
components.description: Native primary control translated for documentation. Generic fill foreground is black; authored quest actions use aubergine.
components.css: .ds-primary-light { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:800; min-height:48px; padding:14px 20px; border:0; border-radius:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms; background:#FE6746; color:#000; } .ds-primary-light:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 100px rgb(0 0 0 / .08); } .ds-primary-light:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #312149; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary-light:active { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 100px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); } .ds-primary-light:disabled { background:#E8D7E2; color:#6A4D67; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary-light { transition:none; } }

components.name: Outlined action
components.description: Solid panel fill, thin outline, unchanged native action semantics.
components.css: .ds-outlined { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:800; min-height:48px; padding:14px 20px; border:0; border-radius:12px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms; padding:12px 16px; background:#FFF8F4; color:#312149; border:1px solid #D6BED2; } .ds-outlined:hover { background:#F7E7F2; } .ds-outlined:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #312149; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-outlined:active { background:#E8D7E2; } .ds-outlined:disabled { color:#6A4D67; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-outlined { transition:none; } }

components.name: Input
components.description: Panel-filled native field; 16px radius, strong focused outline and readable placeholder.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#312149; font:500 15px/1.4 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-field input { padding:16px; border:1px solid #84617F; border-radius:16px; background:#FFF8F4; color:#312149; font:inherit; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#6A4D67; opacity:1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#312149; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #312149; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-field input:disabled { color:#6A4D67; background:#E8D7E2; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Mint active marker, aubergine icon ink; app retains bottom bar or adaptive rail.
components.html: HomeQuestsFriendsProfile
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:8px; min-height:72px; background:#FFF8F4; padding:8px; font:700 12px/1.4 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { flex:1; display:grid; justify-items:center; align-content:center; gap:4px; color:#6A4D67; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav span { display:grid; place-items:center; padding:5px 15px; border-radius:12px; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:#312149; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] span { background:#B7EBCC; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#312149; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #312149; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav a:active span { background:#E8D7E2; }

components.name: Quest panel
components.description: Flat cream tonal layer, 16px corners; title/action content uses existing quest data.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:16px; background:#FFF8F4; color:#312149; border-radius:16px; } .ds-panel h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font:400 29px/1.08 'DM Serif Display',serif; letter-spacing:-.7px; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; font:500 13px/1.4 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; color:#6A4D67; }

narrative.overview:
This system applies **only to the existing Editorial Growth theme**. Brutal
Neutralism and Auralis keep their independent implementation and visual rules.
Do not apply these tokens to shared defaults without the Editorial branch.

Daily effort feels tangible through precise geometric cuts, editorial serif
headings and compact sans-serif controls. The light appearance uses rose paper,
aubergine ink, coral actions and mint notices. The night appearance is composed
from deep aubergine, raised plum surfaces, warm cream type and apricot actions.
The app's English voice stays playful and adult; task information stays direct.
keyCharacteristics: Confirmed progress expressed through authored cut geometry.
Flat color surfaces and a clear serif/sans hierarchy.
Deliberate light and dark palettes with readable text twins.
Native controls, existing actions and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Fill and Ink Rule
rules.body: Coral is an action fill. Small labels and links use the darker readable coral twin in light mode; never use the raw fill as small text on rose or cream. Status text uses `successText`, `warningText` or `danger`.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Keep progress values in readable body type and real quantity/unit formatting. Display type supplies character to headings without turning every control or metric into a headline. Preserve text scaling and reflow the cut marks when the scaled value needs more width.

dos: **Do** confine Cut & Grow changes to Editorial Growth.
**Do** preserve real data, English copy, existing actions and game rules.
**Do** use readable ink tokens on rose, cream and plum surfaces.
**Do** reflow progress geometry for enlarged text and respect reduced motion.
**Do** keep original icon/logo pixels and record raster origins.
donts: **Don't** spread this palette, typography or panel shape to the other themes.
**Don't** show a pending offline check-in as confirmed progress.
**Don't** restore the discarded 3D botanical cover ahead of a daily action.
**Don't** turn legacy uppercase labels into a new eyebrow typography rule.
**Don't** infer iOS runtime or physical-device smoothness from Android captures.
